steps.code:
# Get all downloaded songs (paginate through all pages)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
downloaded_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    downloaded_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Downloaded songs count: {len(downloaded_songs)}")
print(downloaded_songs)

steps.code:
# Loop: go to next song until current song is downloaded
while True:
    # Check current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    if current['song_id'] in downloaded_ids:
        print(f"Reached downloaded song: {current['title']} (id={current['song_id']})")
        break
    # Otherwise go to next song
    print(f"Current song {current['title']} (id={current['song_id']}) not downloaded, going next...")
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song result:", next_result)
